technical_and_design_decisions: Debug and fix role-based access control issue in admin_ui for job creation, focusing on tracing code and log analysis.
Add explicit partition count configuration to Kafka source module by extending configuration properties and updating parsing logic.
Implement dynamic partition subscription in Kafka source module to allow consumption from dynamically assigned partitions.
Add Syncable writes option to HDFS sink for improved resiliency, utilizing HDFS API for synchronous data flushing.
Implement direct filename writes in HDFS sink to avoid temporary suffixes, modifying file handling logic.
Enhance Maven and Gradle plugins to support custom module upload through build target integration.
Add versioning support for custom modules by introducing version tracking in deployment mechanisms.
Certify Spring XD against Pivotal HD 3.0 (PHD 3.0) by performing compatibility testing and environment configuration.
assumptions: The existing Spring XD codebase is modular, allowing changes to be isolated to specific components without major refactoring.
The development environment includes access to the source code, necessary tools, and a test setup for Kafka and HDFS.
Effort estimates are for a single developer and include coding, unit testing, and basic documentation, but exclude extensive integration testing.
No external dependencies or third-party issues will arise during implementation.
The certification process involves testing on a PHD 3.0 environment, and any compatibility issues are assumed to be minor.

activities.activity_name: Fix job creation error in admin_ui
activities.activity_description: Debug and resolve the error encountered when users with ROLE_CREATE or ROLE_ADMIN roles attempt to create jobs from admin_ui, ensuring it works similarly to the shell interface.
Implement support for configuring explicit partition counts in the Kafka source module to enable controlled routing of payloads to consumer modules.

activities.activity_name: Implement dynamic partition subscription for Kafka
activities.activity_description: Add functionality to dynamically subscribe to partitions in the Kafka source module, allowing consumption from partitions that change over time.

activities.activity_name: Add Syncable writes option for HDFS sink
activities.activity_description: Implement an option in the HDFS sink to use Syncable writes, providing better resiliency at the cost of performance, by leveraging HDFS synchronization capabilities.

activities.activity_name: Implement direct filename writes in HDFS sink
activities.activity_description: Add an option to write files directly to the specified filename without using temporary suffixes like .tmp, useful for scenarios with Syncable writes or failure recovery.

activities.activity_name: Add Maven/Gradle support for custom module upload
activities.activity_description: Enhance build tools with Maven and Gradle targets to automate the upload and installation of custom module fragments.

activities.activity_name: Add versioning support for custom modules
activities.activity_description: Implement versioning capabilities for custom modules to allow incremental evolution and seamless upgrades during roll-outs.
Perform certification testing of Spring XD against Pivotal HD 3.0 to ensure compatibility with the latest ODP-based bits, including environment setup and issue resolution.
